_smoke_note: NOT A RESULT AND NEVER QUOTABLE AS ONE. Tiny atoms ladder (64/128/256), gates bypassed. Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: whitener + sealed pool, re-derived M108 patch stream (verified against the whitener), extension draw + appended dictionary construction, frozen float encode at all three atom counts (train + test memmaps), ridge fit + full-test score, t1 reference read, kill switch evaluate, frontier MACs report, evidence write. Every accuracy it produces is meaningless.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens

extension.construction: smoke: sealed-pool prefix (pool 128) + appended extension for atoms 256 (exercises the appended construction; see sealed config)
